items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Jack Lane would talk about the Owls and Davy Crockett... [INTERVIEWEE] But I really couldn't tell you, I don't remember whether it was, it must have been an organization...

ctx.x: Yeah, gee, I'm trying to think of who I played with over there for them. In fact, the musician used to talk about some musician that's, they used to say, he used to get a lot of the funerals way back, he used to say he used to sit on the step and wait for the man to die to get the job, you know. You know what I mean? That's what they, I was just saying, you know. Yeah. Well, I felt a name, I remember, I knew the fellow too, but an older musician, see. But yes, I played some, when I was real young over there in…
Well, Jack Lane would talk about the Owls and Davy Crockett, those different firemen's things and all that sort of stuff.
But I really couldn't tell you, I don't remember whether it was, it must have been an organization, because that's about the only one that it would be for.
